payload.title: Target coefficient regret instead of expanding the path bank
payload.decision: Close E010 as rejected for deployment but validated for candidate coverage. Do not add more path families or repeat flat best-candidate selection next. Prioritize E011/H014: split-local low-dimensional coefficient/control-point prediction with compact family experts, strict E006 fallback, and a memory-safe streaming implementation.
payload.rationale: E010 reaches a 4.7511 bank oracle but only 14.7803 legally. The chosen-family oracle counterfactual is 5.7075, so family identity accounts for 9.5% of the gap and coefficient estimation/aggregation for 90.5%. HMM added no unique screen coverage; DTW derivative is useful only rarely and scores 30.434 standalone.
payload.revisit_trigger: E011 proves coefficient targets are not learnable under repeated/spatial/typewell validation, or a new independently verified public method adds substantial legal oracle coverage below the current 4.7511 bank.
